thread:
sana: just pushed rwd-v5-hybrid-int4 to canary (5% traffic) for smoke. quick readout: p95 latency -18%, cost -28%, overall embed+rerank composite down 1.2pt. attaching sliced deltas. want to propose a z-score based gate + quiet-burn step before promote. thoughts? :rocket:
jules: paste the slice deltas please. which workloads show the hit? :mag:
marco: csv from the run:
```
slice,queries,composite_score,baseline_composite,z_delta
search-short,9500,0.812,0.809,+0.3
faq-retrieval,2200,0.745,0.747,-0.2
long-retrieval,1700,0.603,0.621,-1.8
code-snippet-rank,1300,0.554,0.582,-2.8
```
jules: looks concentrated on long-retrieval and code-snippet-rank. are these high-value slices?
anya: code-snippet-rank has high downstream failure cost (customer impact), long-retrieval is heavy tail. both meet min-volume thresholds for alerts.
sana: I also ran hallucation spot-checks for code snippets: failure rate up 0.4pp from 1.1->1.5. not huge but correlated with MRR drop.
marco: prefer gating on z-score rather than absolute delta for stability across traffic. propose: if zscore(composite_delta, 1h) > 2.5 for any weighted-slice -> auto-throttle to 10% and spawn shadow cohort for 12h. hard rollback if zscore > 3.5 sustained 90m.
jules: ok but add per-slice SLO priorities. code-snippet-rank priority=high, long-retrieval=medium. high-priority should tighten soft trigger to zscore>1.8.
anya: also want an interim "quiet-burn": after canary succeeds 4h with zscore < 1.0, ramp to 20% for 6h before full promote. reduces oscillation.
sana: draft gate config (text blob):
```
metric: composite_score
baseline_window: 7d
soft_trigger: zscore > 2.5 (global)
soft_trigger_high_priority: zscore > 1.8 (high-priority slices)
soft_action: throttle_to 10% ; spawn_shadow 12h ; notify #oncall-eng-ml
hard_trigger: zscore > 3.5 sustained 90m
hard_action: rollback to rwd-v5-int8 ; page SRE
quiet_burn: pass 4h zscore < 1.0 -> ramp to 20% for 6h
min_volume: 500 queries per slice per window
slice_weights: {code-snippet-rank: 2.0, long-retrieval: 1.3}
```
marco: add a composite metric note: composite_score = 0.6 * normalized_rerank_mrr + 0.4 * (1 - halluc_rate_norm) to capture both quality and safety. normalization anchored to 30d baseline.
jules: ops question: for Dedicated customers, do we prefer local fallback (route to int8 pool in same region) vs global rollback? we need a per-customer policy.
anya: policy: Dedicated -> local route + spin standby int8 nodes ; Hosted -> best-effort local then global rollback. update policy doc.
ci-bot: canary smoke: unit-tests ✅ , load-check ✅ , composite-eval WARN (slices: code-snippet-rank, long-retrieval)
sana: next steps: 1) jules update gate config in repo (PR) with per-slice priority tweaks 2) marco implement zscore calc and quiet-burn state machine in autoscaler 3) anya update Dedicated fallback playbook 4) run extended shadow for code-snippet-rank (x6 samples) overnight. tagging @jules for signoff before we turn on auto-throttle. :white_check_mark:
jules: I will open PR and include sample runbook snippets. will review tomorrow after shadow results. :thumbsup:
